user.title: Holiday Lighting
user.description: Choose the lights to use by default and any holidays to start with. You can add and edit holidays later.

data_description.default_lights: Drag to reorder: colors rotate down this list.

schedule.title: Nightly schedule
schedule.description: Turn the lights on when it gets dark, then off after a set time or at a hard off time, whichever comes first.

data_description.use_schedule: When off, the lights run whenever the Enabled switch is on.
data_description.dark_source: What decides it is dark enough to turn the lights on.
data_description.sun_elevation: Dark when the sun is below this angle. Sunset is about -0.8°; civil dusk is -6°.
data_description.lux_sensor: Required when dark detection uses illuminance.
data_description.lux_threshold: Dark when the sensor reads below this.
data_description.on_duration: How long the lights stay on after turning on. Leave empty for no limit.
data_description.off_time: Lights turn off at this time even if the duration has not passed. A time before noon means after midnight. Leave empty for no limit.
data_description.weekend_off_time: Used on Friday and Saturday nights instead of the hard off time. Leave empty to use the same time every night.
data_description.respect_manual: If someone changes or turns off a holiday light by hand, leave that light alone for the rest of the night.
data_description.sun_source: Optional. Use the Sun integration (sun.sun) or any sensor reporting the sun's elevation in degrees. Empty calculates it from your home location. Falls back to the calculation if the entity is unavailable.

error.lux_sensor_required: Choose an illuminance sensor for this dark detection mode.

user.title: Add holiday
user.description: Start from a preset or from scratch.

data.name: Name
data.advent_offset: Days from the First Sunday of Advent

data_description.end: Last day each year, e.g. 12-26. May wrap the new year.
data_description.colors: Add colors with the picker. Drag to reorder; they rotate in this order. The name is optional and is just a label.
data_description.lights: Drag to reorder: colors move down this list each step. Empty uses the default lights.
data_description.brightness: Leave empty to keep each light's current brightness.
data_description.days_before: Turn on this many days before the date.
data_description.days_after: Keep going this many days after the date.
data_description.keyword: Only events whose title contains this. Leave empty for every event.
data_description.calendar: The theme shows on any evening with a matching event.
data_description.mode: Chase moves colors down the lights; Cycle and Fade change every light together; Twinkle picks random colors.
data_description.easter_offset: 0 is Easter Sunday. Negative is before Easter, e.g. -46 for Ash Wednesday; positive is after, e.g. 49 for Pentecost.
data_description.advent_offset: 0 is the First Sunday of Advent. Negative is before it, e.g. -7 for Christ the King; 14 is Gaudete Sunday.
data_description.through_christmas_eve: Keep going until December 24 instead of using days after.

schedule_override.name: Schedule for this holiday
schedule_override.description: Leave empty to use the main schedule.

data_description.all_night: Ignore the duration and off time; turn off when it is light again.
data_description.on_duration: Overrides the main duration for this holiday.
data_description.off_time: Overrides the main and weekend off times for this holiday. A time before noon means after midnight.
